dict.string: snowfell-test-7 Distro testing build — PER-BOARD GITHUB LINK (owner requirement 2026-11-14: “need application link to specific projects listed”): the Portfolio carries a GITHUB column whose per-row “Open in GitHub” opens that board's own GitHub Projects page, and the Board lens carries the same action for the board it shows — both via NSWorkspace in the owner's browser session, both using the board's stored sf_boards.url verbatim (the value has ridden in BoardSummary.url since SF-T2 and showed only as tooltip text; no URL is constructed by template; a board with no stored URL shows no button). Carries test-6 whole: SINGLE-WINDOW navigation (owner verdict 2026-11-14: the test-4 bar replicated on stacked per-lens windows was “haphazard and inconsistent”): one main window, all eight lenses (Portfolio · Board · Staged · Orchestration · Roadmap · Incidents · Storage · Updates) switch its content in place via the one NavigationBar; the filled segment always names the visible lens; no segment press creates or orders another window; Item Detail is an in-place drill-down in the same window (Board segment stays selected); Preferences and the Command Palette are the only auxiliary windows and carry no bar. This build also fixes the test-5 S4 crash on the Staged segment (EXC_BAD_ACCESS in -[AppDelegate showWriteBackQueue:]): the satellite Staged window's lifetime was tied to its closed state (default releasedWhenClosed) while AppDelegate held it as a strong property that was never nilled, so a Staged press after the window had been closed retained a freed object — proven by symbolication of the shipped test-5 binary (files/12). The satellite window no longer exists; the detail window met the same fate in the second crash (files/11 Addendum 2), so Item Detail is a drill-down in the one window too, and every remaining auxiliary window is created releasedWhenClosed = NO. Carries everything test-5 shipped: the Portfolio Updated column on sf_boards.gh_updated_at (bundled registry snapshot v10-0058, SHA-256 3af8e8a8551544931d39cff1899bf7c67a907cb8c510f15cafcf6b3ed37e3dd1), glanceable freshness (Updates ● badge + Portfolio freshness line), the M-09 storage-service bind clamp, decluttered staging language, SF-T12 storage, board-state derivation. CI-compiled from Academy source (AutomatedTechnologies/snowfell); audit + SDS-10 conformance attested by the build line on the shipped artifact 2026-11-12 (Distro files/08 rule; SDS-10 §10.5). Runtime verification is the owner's, at the Air sitting — install from the Distro listing.
